groups.name: datastar.sse
groups.description: JTE Datastar Server-Sent Events (SSE) configuration properties.

properties.name: datastar.csp.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Datastar Content-Security-Policy (CSP) nonce generation and binding to the request lifecycle.

properties.name: datastar.csp.csp-header
properties.description: Whether to add the Content-Security-Policy header to the HTTP response using the fallback filter when Spring Security is not present.

properties.name: datastar.sse.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the Datastar Server-Sent Events (SSE) bean and emitter support.
